definitions.explanation: The month before this one; the previous month. Used to refer to events or states in the month that just passed.

examples.japanese: {先月|せんげつ}{新|あたら}しい{車|くるま}を{買|か}いました。
examples.english: I bought a new car last month.

examples.japanese: {先月|せんげつ}{友達|ともだち}に{会|あ}いました。
examples.english: I met my friend last month.

examples.japanese: {先月|せんげつ}は{忙|いそが}しかったです。{毎日|まいにち}{仕事|しごと}がありました。
examples.english: I was busy last month. I had work every day.

examples.japanese: {先月|せんげつ}{日本語|にほんご}の{勉強|べんきょう}を{始|はじ}めました。
examples.english: I started studying Japanese last month.

examples.japanese: {先月|せんげつ}から{毎朝|まいあさ}{走|はし}っています。とても{大変|たいへん}ですが、{楽|たの}しいです。
examples.english: I've been running every morning since last month. It's tough, but fun.

notes: Part of a time reference series: {先月|せんげつ} (last month), {今月|こんげつ} (this month), {来月|らいげつ} (next month). The {先|せん} prefix means 'previous' or 'before' and also appears in {先週|せんしゅう} (last week).
